eyebrow: Exercise 2: tracing an X error on the d=3 lattice
code:
9 data qubits, 8 ancillas (Lesson 20)
X error on a boundary data qubit touched by exactly 1 Z-type stabilizer

X anticommutes with Z-type stabilizers, commutes with X-type
-> exactly 1 defect appears (that one Z-type stabilizer flips)
-> every other stabilizer on the lattice reads normally
caption: A purely structural lookup — which stabilizers include this qubit in their support — no quantum-state simulation needed.
